title: Policy wording, section 7 — water damage
text: Sudden and accidental discharge of water from plumbing is covered. Damage arising from gradual seepage or lack of maintenance is excluded under clause 7.4.

title: Policy wording, section 12 — excess
text: The standard excess for property claims is 250 EUR per event, reduced to 100 EUR where the insured has held the policy for more than five years.

title: Claims handling standard
text: Every drafted reply must cite the policy clause it relies on and must be approved by a human agent before it is sent to the customer.
